svg.title: IBM Technology Lifecycle Services in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Three of IBM's figures for IBM Technology Lifecycle Services: more than 1 million supported assets worldwide; 11 thousand IBM and other OEM hardware and software products; support and services in more than 140 countries. IBM's footnote to each figure: “Data Source IBM Internal Data.” IBM states no other conditions.
